parameters.question: Compare linear regression evaluation metrics (MSE, RMSE, MAE, R2) from LOOCV and an 80-20 train-test split. LOOCV metrics are deterministic and must match the reference within 5% relative absolute error. Train-test split metrics come from a random split, so they need not match the reference values; they only need a positive R2 and internally consistent MSE, RMSE (sqrt of MSE), and MAE. Column order and header labels may differ.
